name: sheets
description: Headless spreadsheet SDK — a framework-agnostic workbook model with an MIT formula engine (fast-formula-parser), dependency-graph recalculation, and CSV/XLSX/JSON import-export. Ships a `react-spreadsheet`-backed editor from the @hasna/sheets/react entry point and a headless `sheets` CLI. v1 is a library + CLI; the HTTP service (sheets-serve), MCP server (sheets-mcp), and Postgres persistence described in the metadata block are planned surfaces, not yet implemented.
